SELECT company.partner_company_id, company.company_code, company.company_name, company.business_no, company.contact_email, company.contact_phone, company.address, company.use_yn, MAX(partner_user.user_name) FILTER (WHERE partner_user.representative_yn = 'Y' AND partner_user.use_yn = 'Y') AS representative_user_name, COUNT(partner_user.partner_user_id) FILTER (WHERE partner_user.use_yn = 'Y')::integer AS user_count, company.created_at, company.updated_at FROM docs_partner_company company LEFT JOIN docs_partner_user partner_user ON partner_user.partner_company_id = company.partner_company_id AND partner_user.del_yn = 'N' WHERE company.del_yn = 'N'
AND ( company.company_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR company.company_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(company.business_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_partner_user searched_user WHERE searched_user.partner_company_id = company.partner_company_id AND searched_user.del_yn = 'N' AND (searched_user.user_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR searched_user.email ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ) )
GROUP BY company.partner_company_id ORDER BY company.use_yn DESC, company.company_name, company.partner_company_id

SELECT partner_company_id, company_code, company_name, business_no, contact_email, contact_phone, address, use_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM docs_partner_company WHERE partner_company_id = #{value} AND del_yn = 'N'

AND use_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY representative_yn DESC, use_yn DESC, user_name, partner_user_id
